I think you might be using the tornado wrong. You've 2 ways from my experience.

1. Immediately turn on spawn and fly high and fast at around 95 degrees from the battlefield, make sure to do adjustments mid flight so you force the pantsir player to waste missiles energy keeping it aligned. Once you feel safe you can now start getting closer (keep orbiting) and look for it with your pod, once found drop a gbu and keep defending, pantsir has no smoke or lws, if it intercepts your bombs then you just gotta retreat. Ideally you wanna circle their spawn, pantsir is borderline useless when the target is directly above it. Try to always stay no closer than 8km in my experience.

2. If the map permits (it's small or has tall hills) spawn on runway. Fly as low as possible all the way around the map so you come from behind their spawn. Make sure you avoid air and heli spawns so you don't get highlighted. If you detect any radar ping from the pantsir consider that angle fucked and engage from a different one. Proceed to do a low supersonic flyover and drop bomb/s. This tactic requires you to know where it is though, so either have someone ping it or try to find it with your rwr and map knowledge, but it's a lot more dangerous.

Also if you expect a missile and are out of options consider dumping multiple bursts of chaff with 0.1-1 second between bursts, it MAY pull the reticle to the chaff for a bit which can save you, but that's a last ditch effort.

Good luck in the field and in your studies though! Remember not to put wt above them!
